protocol.name: zxr_layer_anchoring_v1
protocol.description:
This protocol assigns layer surfaces a spatial reference frame and a spatial exclusive zone. On a head-mounted display there is no physical output edge; a layer surface's anchor edges are interpreted within the field of view of its assigned frame, and exclusive zones reserve solid angle rather than pixels.
The key words "must", "must not", "required", "shall", "shall not", "should", "should not", "recommended", "may", and "optional" in this document are to be interpreted as described in IETF RFC 2119.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the experimental phase. Backward incompatible changes may be added without bumping the major version of the extension. As such, gating usage on the protocol's presence is discouraged outside spatial-os itself.

entry.name: already_anchored
entry.summary: the layer surface already has an anchoring object

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the manager. Existing anchoring objects are not affected.

request.name: get_anchoring

description.summary: extend a layer surface with spatial anchoring

request.description: Create an anchoring object for the given layer surface. A layer surface may be extended at most once; a second request raises the already_anchored error.

interface.name: zxr_anchored_layer_v1

description.summary: spatial anchoring state of a layer surface

interface.description: Spatial anchoring state for one layer surface. All state set through this interface is double-buffered; it is applied on the next wl_surface.commit of the layer surface.

entry.name: invalid_size
entry.summary: angular size or distance out of range

enum.name: frame
enum.description: The frame the layer surface is positioned in. Head-framed surfaces follow the view; body-framed surfaces follow the user's body orientation without following head rotation; world-framed surfaces hold a pose in the local reference space.

entry.name: body
entry.summary: follows the body, not the head

request.name: destroy
request.description: Remove the spatial anchoring. The layer surface falls back to the compositor's default presentation for its layer.

request.name: set_frame
request.description: Set the reference frame the surface's layer-shell anchor edges are interpreted in. Values set in this way are double-buffered, see wl_surface.commit.

request.name: set_angular_size
request.description: Set the horizontal angular size the surface subtends, in degrees; the compositor derives the presentation distance and height from the surface's aspect ratio. The size must be greater than zero and at most 180, otherwise the invalid_size error is raised. Values set in this way are double-buffered, see wl_surface.commit.

request.name: set_exclusive_angle

description.summary: reserve solid angle at the anchor

request.description: Reserve an angular band along the surface's layer-shell anchor edges, in degrees, that the compositor keeps free of other exclusive-zone-respecting content in the same frame — the spatial analog of zwlr_layer_surface_v1.set_exclusive_zone. A value of zero reserves nothing. Values set in this way are double-buffered, see wl_surface.commit.
